const.validationScope: Static metamodel compilation only; no MSystemState, object binding or operation replay.

const.classMapping: Each EClass becomes a USE class with the same name. abstract=true is preserved.
const.attributeMapping: Each declared EAttribute becomes a scalar USE attribute. The current baseline contains only 0..1 scalar EAttributes. The mapper copies resolved semantic values; it does not invent values for reconstruction-clipped attributes.
const.inheritanceMapping: Each eSuperType becomes USE class inheritance without semantic normalization.

containmentReferenceMapping.firstEndMultiplicity: 0..1 because an EObject has at most one container for this containment link

nonContainmentReferenceMapping.firstEndMultiplicity: * because no eOpposite/reverse bound is declared in this reconstruction

identifierPolicy.metamodelElements: Preserve source spelling and owner-qualified identity exactly. Three USE keyword attributes use explicit reversible targetAttributeEscapes; no Core rename.
identifierPolicy.projectObjectIdentifiers: deterministically sanitize to USE identifiers; preserve original JaCaMo identifier in transformation trace
identifierPolicy.generatedConcreteArtifactClass: use resolved Java simple class name; on collision append a stable short hash of the fully-qualified name

const.sourceExpressionPolicy: Jason expressions, rules, contexts, signal/await expressions and Moise string-valued fields remain String unless a later verified semantic parser introduces a typed representation. They are not silently parsed as OCL.
const.constraintPolicy: Mapping establishes the USE semantic substrate. OCL constraints are maintained separately and bind to mapped USE classes/operations.

evolutionPolicy.addedEClassOrFeature: generate mapping suggestion using generic rules but mark REVIEW_REQUIRED before accepting
evolutionPolicy.removedOrRenamedElement: mark stale mapping and BLOCK; never silently retarget by name similarity
evolutionPolicy.versioning: increment mapping minor version for compatible additions; major version for semantic/breaking changes

source.const: Parsed JaCaMo project: concrete CArtAgO artifact implementation type referenced by the project

const.rule: Generate one concrete USE subclass of Artifact per distinct resolved artifact implementation type.

source.const: Parsed concrete observable property owned by a concrete Artifact instance/type
Parsed concrete CArtAgO operation owned by a concrete Artifact implementation

const.name: resolved operation name
const.resultType: resolved result type when meaningful, otherwise no result

target.const: Keep the mapped USE association from ExternalAction to AbsOperation and, when VP003 exists, add transformation trace from the AbsOperation object to its projected USE operation.
Use mapped USE association unchanged. VP002 may additionally expose the concrete state value as an artifact attribute.

source.const: Norm, Nrole, NMission and their attributes

target.const: Represent Norm as USE class/object plus associations only.

const.identityRule: Feature identity always includes declaring owner; bare feature names are not lookup keys. Inherited features resolve through their declaring owner.
const.reverseRoleRule: Retain unique source_<feature>; for colliding reverse roles use source_<declaringOwner>_<feature>. Legacy ambiguous aliases are not valid identifiers.
const.orderingRule: Copy EReference ordered/unique metadata; ordered=true on many-valued forward USE association ends; inverse order is unspecified.
const.containmentRule: Map source containment to USE composition at firstEnd; per-link inverse 0..1. No runtime global-container guarantee is asserted by a metamodel declaration.
const.valueRule: Preserve EType/default provenance. USE scalar values can be undefined; applying source defaults and distinguishing unset from effective default belong to later materialization.
const.projectionRule: VP001-003 are typed metamodel templates with explicit external-input preconditions, not concrete target declarations. VP004-007 reuse existing structural bindings without duplicating them.
const.compatibility: 1.1.0 adds schema/contract/projection anchors and order metadata. Eight previously ambiguous, invalid USE reverse roles are repaired; C/A/R/I IDs, source keys and forward names are unchanged. Consumers of legacy reverse strings must use the documented replacement names. Three source attribute names rejected by the USE lexer (from, Sequence) receive explicit target-only escapes; source keys remain unchanged.
